name: chargeback-cost-analysis
description: Elastic Chargeback data model and cost arithmetic: which indices hold cost and usage, how per-data-stream cost is derived as a share of an allocatable pool, why allocated costs do not sum to the invoice, how Serverless projects differ from Hosted deployments, and the one-day billing lag.
